name: lallpi
description: Dependency manifest for the LALLPI site's Netlify Functions. The site itself is a Quarto/Python project with no other Node.js tooling -- this file exists solely so Netlify's function bundler can resolve @netlify/blobs, which netlify/functions/download-count.mjs imports. Netlify automatically runs npm install from this file as a pre-build step, before the custom [build] command in netlify.toml runs.
